claim: BPD showed a strong positive genetic correlation with PTSD.
phenotype_definition: BPD phenotype assembled across clinical DSM-IV and biobank/cohort ascertainment strategies in the source meta-analysis.
allowed_interpretation: BPD and PTSD show substantial shared common genetic effects.
The result supports shared genetic liability between the two phenotypes.
forbidden_interpretation: A person with PTSD will develop BPD.
limitations: Genetic correlation does not establish causal direction.
Comorbidity, overlapping symptoms, and diagnostic misclassification cannot be fully disentangled.
The source GWAS was based on participants of European ancestry, limiting generalizability.
